question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.enthalpy_definition: Reaction enthalpy of phosphocreatine hydrolysis and ATP resynthesis (Kodama 1985). Quantifies purely calorimetric heat exchange.
question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.gibbs_definition: Thermodynamic Gibbs free energy of ATP hydrolysis under physiological intracellular conditions (Meyerspeer 2021). Quantifies maximum mechanical cross-bridge work potential.
question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.harmonization_verdict: Formulas strictly segregated: P_mech = eta_loc * v_ATP * (-dG_ATP) uses 54.0 kJ/mol; Q_heat = v_ATP * (-dH_CK) uses 21.0 kJ/mol. Capacity in work units vs heat units explicitly distinct.

EXP-0038.title: Biophysical Forward Simulation Model of Motor Unit Recruitment, Volume Conductor Filtering, and SAT Attenuation

fatigue_dissociation.finding: During fatigue, sEMG RMS paradoxically increases (+14%) despite a 35% drop in mechanical force in this forward simulation scenario, demonstrating that single-channel sEMG RMS cannot be treated as a monotonic proxy for metabolic activation without high-density multi-channel arrays and subcutaneous morphometry.

fatigue_force_emg_dissociation.finding: During fatigue, sEMG RMS paradoxically increases (+14%) despite a 35% drop in mechanical force in this forward simulation scenario, demonstrating that single-channel sEMG RMS cannot be treated as a monotonic proxy for metabolic activation without high-density multi-channel arrays and subcutaneous morphometry.

core_findings: At 12.7% measured sEMG RMS, variation in subcutaneous fat thickness (3 to 10 mm) induces a 40.9-fold uncertainty span in true active muscle volume fraction a_eff (0.018 to 0.737) in forward simulation.

During simulated muscle fatigue, sEMG RMS paradoxically increases by +14.0% while mechanical twitch force drops by -35.0% due to conduction velocity slowing and intracellular action potential widening.
Single-channel sEMG RMS is structurally unidentifiable with respect to active muscle volume fraction without high-density multi-channel arrays and independent subcutaneous tissue morphometry.

EXP-0041.title: SUBJECT-01 Integration: Functional Power, Recovery Limits, and TARGET-CPE45 Boundaries

cpe45_energy_accounting.external_work_description: 250 W maintained over 2700 s (45 minutes) = 675 kJ. Illustrative test scenario.
cpe45_energy_accounting.scaling_barrier_explanation: Local single-muscle PCr buffer is a rapid transient energy store (duration ~5-30 s). 45-minute continuous endurance work requires systemic aerobic ATP resynthesis (metabolic expenditure ~3375 kJ), constrained by cardiac output, pulmonary gas exchange, and whole-body vascular distribution. Local MRS kinetics cannot be scaled to whole-body critical power without an independent cardiorespiratory model.
